text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — legal asked for a clearer audit-log surface in the Console. They want: who changed what/when, per-tenant exports, and ability to filter by resource/action. Any quick wins?

Maria Gomez: We already emit an event stream from the control plane (chronicle). Right now Console only shows a tiny changelog on the billing page. No cross-resource activity view.

Sam Rodriguez: Key asks from security: immutable events, tamper-evidence (signed events or append-only store), retention policy configurable per tenant, and exports with ACLs. Also need to prove delivery for SOC2.

AJ: UX idea — add an "Activity" tab on each resource (API key, model route, quota config). And a top-level "Audit" page with search (actor, action, resource, time) + CSV/NDJSON export. Minimal MVP: filter + CSV export.

Priya Patel: CSV export is good. Legal also wants exports to include full diff (what changed) not just "update". So we need before/after fields and optional payload.

Maria Gomez: Backend can be extended to store event payloads (small diffs). We need to pick event schema. Something like:

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "timestamp": "2024-06-25T16:07:00Z",
  "actor": "maria.g@redwood.com",
  "actor_type": "user",
  "action": "update",
  "resource": "route:prod-search",
  "resource_id": "route:prod-search",
  "before": {"concurrency": 4},
  "after": {"concurrency": 8},
  "ip": "18.194.2.5",
  "method": "console",
  "trace_id": "trace_..."
}
```

Maria Gomez: We can stream these to a write-once store (S3 with versioning + server-side encryption) and to an internal event DB for fast queries.

Sam Rodriguez: If we write to S3, we need signed manifests for integrity and log checksums for verification. Also require that exports to external buckets must be allowed only after Legal sign-off per customer region (GDPR).

AJ: For Console UX, CSV should map to columns: timestamp, actor, actor_email, action, resource_type, resource_id, before_json, after_json, method, ip. NDJSON export for large sets.

Priya Patel: Nice. Also need API for programmatic exports: GET /v1/audit/export?start=...&end=...&format=ndjson&resource=route:prod-search — with RBAC checks.

Maria Gomez: Agree. We should also add a streaming webhook option for customers to receive events in near-real-time. We already have a webhook infra; need to add retry/backoff and delivery guarantees.

Compliance Bot: Reminder: retention defaults must meet SOC2 minimums. Also add an "export audit trail" — who exported logs and where. :locked: 

Sam Rodriguez: Important: log access must be logged. So an export action becomes an event too (who exported, target bucket, checksum). That event must be immutable.

AJ: What about performance? Indexing every tiny change could be heavy. Suggest sampling for metrics but full events only for control-plane ops (config changes, rollout actions). Token-generation / inference requests should stay in telemetry pipeline, not audit store.

Maria Gomez: Implementation plan suggestion: 
- Phase 1 (MVP, 4w): event schema + persist diffs for control-plane changes, basic Console Activity view, CSV/NDJSON export, API endpoint, export-event logging.
- Phase 2 (8w): streaming webhooks, S3 archival with checksums + retention UI, region-aware export controls, signed manifests.
- Phase 3 (optional): append-only ledger (signed chain) for highest-compliance customers, UI for legal downloads, per-tenant retention policies.

Priya Patel: Proposed owners: Maria (backend/event storage), AJ (Console UX), Sam (security review), Priya (product + legal sync). Targets look reasonable.

Maria Gomez: I'll put up a short RFC with schema and API contract tomorrow. Will include sample NDJSON export and estimated cost.

deploy-bot: deploy started by maria.g on infra-audit-schema branch — build 98. :rocket:

Priya Patel: Great — thanks everyone. Can we sync with Legal Friday to confirm export constraints? :calendar:
